verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a plugin model: Functions, Tools, Pipes and Filters are modular Python plugins. Its site also invites users to "Share what you build, run what others share," which implies a community sharing ecosystem. Nothing in the pack shows the ecosystem's size, how many published items exist, or whether maintainers are active. missing for 10: evidence of thousands of published plugins/skills/presets, evidence of active maintainers, a documented community marketplace/hub with metrics, independent corroboration of ecosystem vitality.
